context: M28 escort leg 2: Broadway & W 32nd to Herald Square. The crowd swells. Moretti hands out flowers.

lines.speaker: char.anna_moretti
lines.text: Flowers for the marchers! Moretti says take one! Mind the fronds!

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Used-to-be! You're in front! Look at you, used-to-be!

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: We closed the shop for this. Mrs. Baek says it's an investment.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Who owns the Tenderloin, Mr. Arce?
